top_signals.title: Baltimore suburb confirms August data breach after ransomware claims
top_signals.summary: Anne Arundel County, Maryland, said an intruder stole files from government systems, and investigators are working to assess how much data was exposed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: BNY Targets Blind Spots in ABS After Tricolor Mess Rocked Market
top_signals.summary: A year after a pair of massive frauds exposed hidden risks in otherwise routine financial documents, BNY is rolling out tools to safeguard against blind spots in the roughly $1 trillion asset-backed securities market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
